import sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/app'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/fz')
import main, ref
MODES=["RNE","RNA","RTZ","RUP","RDN"]

def run(ebits,fbits):
    width=1+ebits+fbits
    nd=(width+3)//4
    pats=[format(v,'0{}x'.format(nd)) for v in range(1<<width)]
    cnt=0
    for a in pats:
        for b in pats:
            for mode in MODES:
                req={"ebits":ebits,"fbits":fbits,"mode":mode,"pairs":[[a,b]]}
                ra=main.solve(req); rb=ref.ref_solve(req)
                if (int(ra["bits"],16),tuple(sorted(ra["flags"])))!=(int(rb["bits"],16),tuple(sorted(rb["flags"]))):
                    print("MISMATCH",req,ra,rb); return False
                cnt+=1
    print("exhaustive single-pair ok",ebits,fbits,cnt)
    return True
